text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A special feature on C.B.-san... Ah! And 
Teio-san is in this one too! Nngh~! These 
are going into my permanent collection!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, isn't Teio the one 
you look up to? I believe Rudolf mentioned 
that to me before.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's pure 'admiration'! I can feel 
the power and confidence of her run 
radiating right through this photo...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Looking at this makes me want to reach 
Teio-san's level one day too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't catch up yet, I want to 
keep running so that one day I can truly 
reach the one I look up to...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then maybe one day you'll be 
featured like this too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? D-Do you think so!? ...Does that 
mean I might get to do an interview with 
Teio-san...hang on, really...!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, C.B.-san! How did it feel to do a 
photoshoot with Rudolf-san and all those 
famous Umamusume?!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... How did that go again? Haha, I 
might not remember too well. It wasn't 
really anything special, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-Wow... That's amazing! If it were me, 
I'd get so nervous my face would stiffen 
right up...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, I don't really remember 
how I felt back then... but it sure is 
interesting.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Even the time I've forgotten remains in 
someone else's hands. ...Yeah, that's 
interesting.
